final: WITH c AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), t AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total, COUNT(*) AS k FROM c) SELECT c.ID, c.n AS num_examinations, c.n * 1.0 / t.total AS share, c.n * 1.0 / t.total - 1.0 / t.k AS margin_above_avg FROM c, t WHERE c.n * 1.0 / t.total > 1.0 / t.k ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC, c.ID LIMIT 10
